## Appearance

Damaris Treleaven possesses a stunning beauty coupled with city sophistication. Her appearance is so striking that she resembles a painting.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P56](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0056), [v5 CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P1](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0001)_
